loop.top3_why_not: Candidate B (weighted inverse‑error) has a higher validation score and a larger gap to the leader; its performance is slightly worse in the first and third windows and relies on weight estimation that can be unstable with only three validation windows. Candidate C (simple mean) is marginally worse than the trimmed‑mean across all windows and does not benefit from trimming outlier models. Therefore, A is preferred for its balance of stability and accuracy.
